title: Rhubarb Cheesecake
description: This rhubarb cheesecake made with fresh rhubarb and finished with a sour cream topping is an unique and exquisite dessert that's sure to impress.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Combine 1 cup flour, 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 cup butter in a medium bowl; mix until crumbly and pat into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.

Toss chopped rhubarb, 1/2 cup sugar, and 1 tablespoon flour together; pour onto crust and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar together in a large bowl until creamy; beat in eggs one at a time. Pour mixture over hot rhubarb in the pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until filling is set, about 30 minutes. Cover with sour cream topping while still hot.
To make the sour cream topping: Combine 1 cup sour cream, 2 tablespoons sugar, and 1 teaspoon vanilla in a small bowl. Mix well and spread on top of cake.

video.description: Enjoy the rich decadence of classic cheesecake paired with tart rhubarb and a smooth sour cream topping. Begin by making a simple crust of flour, sugar and butter, then top with chopped rhubarb macerated in sugar and flour. After the crust has baked, top with a blend of cream cheese, sugar and eggs. When this rich layer has baked and set, complete with a topping of sour cream, sugar and vanilla. Wait until everything’s cool, then cut big slices of dessert happiness and pass them around!
